description: Measurement of ship-generated waves in German coastal waterways from 1998–2022 is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Arne Seemann et al. Vessel-generated waves and currents significantly impact coastal and estuarine waterways. In-situ measurements record all relevant physical phenomena that occur under a wide range of conditions and are therefore a valuable resource in the investigation of ship waves. Here we present a compound dataset from in-situ ship wave measurement campaigns conducted over several decades in German coastal waterways. Coverage: national (DE); published in 2025. Formats: ZIP, CSV, MATLAB, Image. The data are held in Bundesanstalt für Wasserbau and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
